_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate favors HOLD; spot psychology neutral inside/near Complacency band and no single liquidity or sentiment breaker is clean enough to force a rung jump.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative only affirms current Anxiety with low confidence and no clear forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC drifts with fear_greed 45-55 and ETF flows remain flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 40 with downside acceleration, or ETF flows reverse hard and fear_greed pushes above 60
